decisions: The everyday Home is built by its own door into FOLDER/home (never the person's real home); the window walking it runs with HOME=FOLDER/home and Graphite's workspace at ~/Concern/Ledger as a fresh install keeps it. Not offered in Guide ▸ Try (a demo there would write into the owner's real home folder).

Files are written directly (PDFs byte by byte like Home Demo, ODT/ODS with K5's package helpers, photos with QImage/QPainter shapes only, sounds as integer square waves): deterministic, no LibreOffice or window system needed to build.

The two missing routes were added as the desk's own work (no model): the spending question as a read through registered tool 18 with its receipts; tidy/put back through K4's PLAN_VERBS hook (as K9's replace), registry tools 6 and 7 only, origins as deductions said in words. No new Kernel operation, so no registry change.
"Authorise all n steps" is offered first only for more than three waiting steps; the Kernel's "all" still leaves a step that must be authorised by its own name.
The one-press grant for a move into a subfolder is the grant on the outer folder (a folder grant already covers its subfolders); it never widens beyond the folders the step names.

In the walk: typing and saving in LibreOffice were stood in by UNO over the window's pipe (no keyboard here); the network state was reported as K8's frames did; logind was patched (nothing issued); move steps were slowed 0.6 s in session 10 so HALT had a middle to land in; the walk placed Graphite below its dock because the stand-in manager reads no strut. Each is said in the account.

My throwaway copy's seed is made current (package_graphite.py --manifest-only, in the copy only) before each walk, as a merge does: without it her desk answered "Graphite seed/source binding is not current".
